source.author: stat
source.text: Sacra Iovi merito Tyrius pro fulmine ductor nequiquam Danaos ratus exarmasse ferebat, nec pater aetherius divomque has ullus ad aras, sed mala Tisiphone trepidis inserta ministris astat et inferno praevertit vota Tonanti.
source.text_original: Sacra Iovi merito Tyrius pro fulmine ductor / nequiquam Danaos ratus exarmasse ferebat, / nec pater aetherius divomque has ullus ad aras, / sed mala Tisiphone trepidis inserta ministris / astat et inferno praevertit vota Tonanti.
source.text_english: The Tyrian leader was carrying sacred offerings to Jupiter in gratitude for the thunderbolt, thinking he had disarmed the Danaans in vain; nor did any heavenly father or god stand at these altars, but evil Tisiphone, inserted among the trembling attendants, stands by and forestalls prayers to the thunderer of the underworld.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: Tartareo turn sacra Iovi Stygiisque ferebat manibus Alcimede tanto super auxia nato, siquid ab excitis melius praenosceret umbris.
reuse.text_original: Tartareo turn sacra Iovi Stygiisque ferebat / manibus Alcimede tanto super auxia nato, / siquid ab excitis melius praenosceret umbris.
reuse.text_english: Then Alcimede was bringing sacred rites to Tartarean Jove and to the Stygian spirits, as an added support for her mighty son, if from the summoned shades she might learn anything better in advance.
